architecture_decisions: {Can be implemented as a bounded autonomous correction controller that addresses reproducible implementation, BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, browser, screenshot, visual and provider failure evidence into typed repair attempts, while preserving last-known-good lineage and explicit human/resource boundaries.}
work_items: {Implement a bounded autonomous correction controller that addresses reproducible implementation, BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, browser, screenshot, visual and provider failure evidence into typed repair attempts, while preserving last-known-good lineage and explicit human/resource boundaries.}
validations: {Ensure the bounded autonomous correction controller addresses reproducible implementation, BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, browser, screenshot, visual and provider failure evidence into typed repair attempts, while preserving last-known-good lineage and explicit human/resource boundaries.}

AC-01: validate protected requirement — IMPLEMENT, BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, browser deterministic, screenshot, visual and provider failures normalize into stable bounded defect evidence tied to the exact Project/run/Work-Spec/source-lineage/Preview facts where applicable. Raw unbounded logs/DOM/images/provider payloads, secrets, private reasoning and unrelated Project data are rejected.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — The controller uses deterministic failure > protected acceptance > screenshot regression > multimodal judgment precedence. Lower-precedence improvement cannot compensate for a new higher-precedence failure, and multimodal PASS cannot override deterministic/protected/screenshot failure.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Planner output identifies exact target defects and bounded source patch proposals but exposes no direct filesystem/shell/HTTP/provider/deployment capability and cannot change Work Specification acceptance, evaluator thresholds, browser baselines/workflows, tool authority or provider targets.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — The controller can only advance through a protected mutation runtime that returns a new immutable accepted lineage. Every new lineage receives fresh protected validation; stale evidence from a prior lineage cannot satisfy the candidate.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — LKG survives failed/regressive repair attempts and process recreation. A candidate replaces LKG only when its protected quality vector is lexicographically better. Equal/worse candidates cannot overwrite LKG.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Attempt, cumulative churn, compute, elapsed runtime, repeated-defect, no-progress and oscillation limits are server-owned, finite and enforced. The model/controller cannot increase them, and exhaustion returns a typed stop reason without further mutation.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Repeated equivalent defect fingerprints and alternating previously observed failing states are identified from bounded canonical fingerprints. The reference harness proves same-defect repetition and A/B/A-style oscillation stop before unbounded repair churn.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Explicit approval, destructive/privileged work, material specification ambiguity and non-refreshable missing credential/authorization stop with typed human/resource reasons. The controller does not patch around these boundaries or misrepresent them as passing validation.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Reproducible bounded failures can produce a dispatch record with exact Project/run/spec/lineage/LKG/evidence/dependency binding and receiving workstream class. Dispatch itself creates no GitHub issue, source mutation, provider mutation, ownership grant or production action.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Correction checkpoints reuse the accepted worker execution/lease/checkpoint contract, retain current and LKG lineage plus bounded evidence/stop metadata, and do not create a competing recovery identity. Existing worker retry/no-progress/oscillation bounds remain outer authority.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Reconstructing the controller from durable run/checkpoint/correction evidence resumes the same bounded session, retains LKG/budget/fingerprint state and replays accepted operation keys without creating duplicate source mutation or provider publication.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — P2-V0.16.3 has authentic committed DSPy critic/compiler evidence. The exact worker head passes Workstream Spec Validation, P2 CI, Bounded Autonomy and the correction/convergence reference harness after reconciliation to accepted P2-V0.16.1 and P2-V0.16.2 contracts. Final Wave 3 integration reruns cumulative protected gates.
